constraints.description: Every provenance acceptance claim has direct evidence.

validation.validation_method: history, manifest, verifier, unit, and BDD evidence

constraints.description: One canonical Dart owner and the non-public provenance boundary remain intact.

validation.validation_method: workspace, export, package, release, and docs ledgers

constraints.description: Exclusions, tampering, duplicate ownership, and publication overclaims fail closed.
Visual evidence is legible, hash-bound, and limited to source lineage.
Runtime, platform, legal, security, certification, and publication limits remain explicit.
All deterministic archive gates pass without hidden mandatory skips.

validation.validation_method: clean/focused gate set and skip audit

global_rules: pnpm is the only JavaScript package manager.
The provenance import must never become a build or publication package.
Archiving this change cannot authorize publication or full-release certification.
Headless lineage evidence cannot be described as Flutter UI or accessibility certification.
termination_conditions: Terminate only when blocking validation failures are zero.
Terminate with publicationAuthorized=false and all downstream owners explicit.
